"Hold On" is a song by Canadian singer Justin Bieber, released on March 5, 2021. It serves as the fourth single from his sixth studio album, "Justice" (2021). The song was written by Bieber in collaboration with producers Andrew Watt and Louis Bell, as well as songwriters Ali Tamposi and Jon Bellion.

Musically, "Hold On" is a pop track with an upbeat tempo and incorporates elements of synth-pop and electronic music. The song features a catchy guitar riff and an energetic, driving rhythm. Its lyrics revolve around themes of hope, resilience, and perseverance in the face of struggles. Bieber offers reassurance and support, encouraging listeners to hold on through difficult times.

The music video for "Hold On" was released simultaneously with the song and directed by director Colin Tilley. It depicts a narrative in which Bieber's character is motivated by the need to save a loved one who is facing a life-threatening illness. The video touches on themes of desperation, love, and sacrifice, complementing the song's message of hope and determination.

"Hold On" received generally positive reviews from music critics, who praised Bieber's vocal performance and the song's infectious melody. It charted in various countries worldwide and added to Bieber's long list of hits, further solidifying his presence in the pop music industry.

The song has been performed during several live events and television appearances, contributing to its popularity and demonstrating Bieber's consistent ability to connect with his audience through relatable themes and engaging performances.
